recognize_zh: 中央那顆胞質藍色的細胞裡，染色體排成上下兩條平行的深紫色帶狀，正往兩極分開，是典型的有絲分裂後期（anaphase）；周圍還有破碎的細胞與幾顆早期造血前驅細胞。
features: Central cell with basophilic cytoplasm containing two parallel bands of condensed chromosomes (anaphase figure)
No nuclear membrane; chromosome sets separated toward opposite poles
Adjacent smudged/disrupted cells with fibrillar cytoplasm
Background erythroid precursors and myeloid cells at the left; red cells in clumps
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cell with basophilic cytoplasm in which two parallel bands of condensed chromosomes are separating toward opposite poles, consistent with a mitotic figure in anaphase. The surrounding field contains smudged cells with fibrillar cytoplasm and scattered erythroid and myeloid precursors. The mitosis appears bipolar and symmetric. Findings are consistent with a normal mitotic figure in a proliferating bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Abnormal mitoses show tripolar spindles, lagging chromosomes or asymmetric chromatin masses, whereas this figure is bipolar and symmetric.
Binucleate cells have two intact nuclei with nuclear membranes and nucleoli, not condensed chromosome bands.
Apoptotic cells show round dense nuclear fragments with shrunken cytoplasm rather than organized chromosome plates.
